sourceScope.ownerUseGrant: 역사 데이터의 기존 가격과 이미 확보된 PIT 팩터를 사용할 수 있다.
sourceScope.ownerRestriction: 기존 replay-v16, US-MF-1, P4 one-shot 연구의 봉인된 데이터·실행 잠금·결과를 절대 수정하거나 소비하지 않는다.
sourceScope.conservativeApplication: Do not read replay-v16 price payloads or their exported copies until scope is clarified; no existing study execution, results or locks are consumed.
sourceScope.notABlanketBudgetBan: AGENTS.md v2.24 closes the existing 31-feature matrix, not every new accounting-quality axis.

signalGrid: Last US trading session of each completed week; 2013-01-04 through last complete week at permitted source cutoff. No outcome-based start/end selection.
execution: First US session AFTER signal, at close; a cash anchor precedes the first fill. No same-close fill.
universe: Dated S&P500 snapshot strictly before signal; verified issuer links only; exclude Financials/Real Estate and unclassified sectors. No current-survivor universe backfill.
completeCase: Identical finite 252-session price history and all four accounting fields for EVERY score and ablation, selected before labels. At least 30 names.
B0: SPY buy-and-hold on exactly the same start/end; verified total-return basis required for certified TR. A reconstructed index must be labelled as such, never as verified raw price return.

B1.volatility: sample std of 252 daily returns x sqrt(252)
B1.portfolio: equal-weight top quintile, ceil(n/5), ticker tie-break

B2.portfolio: equal-weight top quintile, same complete cases as B1

filingVisibility: CP.features_as_of: strictly after max(availableFrom,acceptedDate); 180-day period-end freshness; reuse proven fiscal-stage/TTM helpers; no imputation.
B2_PLUS_VALUE: WITHHELD until historical price/share basis is independently reliable; no fabricated market cap.

B3.constraints: <=5 equal-weight names, sector<=2, no leverage; production select_portfolio_by_scores reused
B3.economicGate: Original net-excess gate requires a valid point-in-time expected-return estimate for THIS score. Rank alone is not expected return. No legacy model/calibration reused.
B3.missingForecast: NOT_ESTIMABLE; not an observed cash strategy and not 0% return
B3.forcedDiagnostic: Rank top <=5 with identical sector cap; explicitly FORCED_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_INVESTABLE_EVIDENCE

costs.costPayment: self-financing; pay fees before setting post-trade weights; gross shadow path for drag

labels.definition: Entry next session close; exit entry index + H; no last-price payoff. Any absent cohort endpoint -> UNRESOLVED whole date, never delete an inconvenient name.
labels.statistics: Descriptive mean weekly rank IC, paired B2-B1 IC, top-minus-bottom quintile and top-minus-SPY; no p values, inference or OOS claim

ablation: Leave out each of five B2 families, equal-weight remaining four, SAME original full complete-case set; no tuning.
metrics: annualized CAGR difference vs SPY (not statistical alpha)
Sharpe with explicit zero risk-free assumption
currentCandidates: CURRENT_CANDIDATES_NOT_VERIFIED unless prices, visible filings and dated membership all verified at current signal date; no stale historical picks promoted.
unresolved: Missing signal is unavailable, not an explicit cash order. Missing held daily observation refuses path; no synthetic liquidation. Never reset/restart the equity curve to hide gaps.
publication: Aggregate analytical results only; no third-party price payload, per-security forward labels, or prohibited sealed-study result reuse.
